paragraphs.text: Ambush Party is an obsolete two-word creature type class for those who attack by surprise.

Ambush Party debuted as a creature type in Homelands on the eponymous card Ambush Party . It was later physically reprinted in Fifth Edition but has not been since. The type was later dropped in the Grand Creature Type Update , and it was given errata to be a Human Rogue . It did recieve its new type line digitally in Magic Online in the Masters Edition II set. To represent their ambushing, they have first strike and haste .

One Ambush Party was two thieves who were paid by Eron the Relentless to wait in a castle and ambush two other thieves on Ulgrotha . Another has been seen waiting behind turns on the roads to Koskun Keep . On Dominaria , Tor Wauki was known to ambush, believing in survival over chivalry, and would hide behind trees in the forest to ambush.
